Speech models distributed with SkoWork

NVIDIA Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3, converted to the sherpa-onnx int8 format:
https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3
Licensed by NVIDIA under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
The distributed ONNX files are quantized and converted versions of the model.

OpenAI Whisper small, converted to the sherpa-onnx int8 format:
https://github.com/openai/whisper (MIT; see whisper-MIT.txt).

Silero VAD:
https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad (MIT; see silero-vad-MIT.txt).

pyannote segmentation 3.0, converted to int8:
https://huggingface.co/pyannote/segmentation-3.0
MIT; see models/stt/pyannote-segmentation-3-0/LICENSE.

WeSpeaker ResNet34-LM:
https://github.com/wenet-e2e/wespeaker/blob/master/docs/pretrained.md
The VoxCeleb-trained model is licensed under CC BY 4.0; see CC-BY-4.0.txt.
WeSpeaker source code is licensed under Apache License 2.0; see
sherpa-onnx-Apache-2.0.txt for that license text.

The pinned conversion archives and checksums are listed in THIRD-PARTY.md.
